item.title: The R in ORM
item.description: The R stands for Relation. Any SQL query defines a relation, and an ORM’s whole job is to map that collection of objects to objects in your language — nothing more.

item.title: The Update Anomaly: Why Normalization Matters
item.description: Storing the same fact in more than one row creates a predictable failure mode: a partial update leaves the database inconsistent, with no way to know which copy is correct.
